  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section opens the maamar with the heading and the date of the 13th of Tishrei, the yahrtzeit of the Rebbe Maharash.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">With the help of Heaven.</t>
    <t s="1">13 Tishrei</t>
    <t s="2">(Yahrtzeit of the Rebbe Maharash),</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section gives the precise time of the discourse: the eve of the holiday of Sukkos, 5738.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">Erev Sukkos,</t>
    <t s="1">5738*.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section notes that the maamar is a transcript (hanachah).</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">Transcript.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
